questions.question: How did Moses confirm the covenant with the people?
options: By writing it on a scroll and sealing it
By a solemn handshake before the elders
By sprinkling the blood of the covenant
By sharing a meal on the mountainside
questions.answer: By sprinkling the blood of the covenant

questions.question: What happened when Moses went up the mountain to God?
options: The glory of the LORD settled, and he stayed forty days and nights
A cloud hid him while the elders waited at the foot below
A violent and terrible storm forced him back down before he reached the very top
He spoke with God briefly and returned that same evening
questions.answer: The glory of the LORD settled, and he stayed forty days and nights
